title: The Distribution and Consequences of Natural Disasters
discussion_signal: The post describes wildfire damage as an income and community-composition shock, with multi-year losses for directly damaged households and slow, selective reoccupation. It adds a social recovery lens to the atlas record: rebuilding does not necessarily restore the prior population or economic trajectory.
linked_research_question: How does wildfire destruction alter income, return, housing security, and who remains in a community over time?
limits: The post summarizes a study and does not expose its full design
Direct property damage is not equivalent to general wildfire exposure
Observed reoccupation patterns do not establish the policy cause of migration
